firewall-manager-review-policy-associati.title: Review policy associations and inheritance to cut policy charges
firewall-manager-review-policy-associati.body: This estimate pays for several firewall policy-regions. Microsoft advises reviewing Firewall Manager policies, associations and inheritance, because a policy is billed per region once it has two or more firewall associations (and a billed child policy also carries its parent), while a policy with zero or one association is free.

citation.source: Architecture best practices for Azure Firewall (Cost Optimization)
citation.quote: Review your Firewall Manager policies, associations, and inheritance carefully to optimize cost.
